_comment: Functions tools/covreport.py leaves out of the coverage totals: code that is built and kept, but that the shipped game cannot run, so no clean-room test can reach it. Per program: a name or an fnmatch pattern (names, not CosUtil_*: the costume loader itself uses CosUtil_AddComponent, CosUtil_ComponentInfo, CosUtil_CountComponents, CosUtil_PtrFromHandle and CosUtil_SetChoreLength) (the gcov name without its leading _ or @ and its @N stdcall suffix) -> why. The lines left out are counted in the report's Excluded column; covreport.py --no-exclude counts everything.
